__INITIAL_STATE__.$_search.gridData.data.description:
Vintage 1992 501s Highly Distressed 5 Button Fly Denim Jeans Levi's Labeled size 11 (today's equivalent approx 26)

Levi's famous 501 button fly style loved for decades for their legendary fit of straight leg & high rise. A classic piece of Americana heritage style. Early 90's detailing of ultra light faded denim look & incredible 5 button fly. Levi branding stamped hardware. Classic touches of yellow gold contrast stitch & 5 pocket styling. Super soft 100% cotton. Premium selvedge construct. USA made craftsmanship shown in top button factory stamp 544. A highly deconstructed distressed pair of 501's that give an authentic broken in vintage Levi's look. Genuine vintage distressing & wear adds to the visual history. Some include- discoloration on top & lower left legs, frayed holes, missing labels, & ripped belt loops. Please view all photos for condition. A perfect pair for a 90's enthusiast or creative that loves to upcycle unique vintage pieces. Cool classic casual denim with a story of its own in this authentic pair of 1992 Vintage Levi's 501s.
